name: Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help at events at the Space Center and around Los Angeles. You also go to meetings and trainings of one to two hours.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 16. You must pass a background check and know Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for the year as of Nov 3, 2026. The next cycle opens in January 2027. No exact date is posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the volunteer page when the next round opens. In 3 to 5 business days you hear if you can come to a talk and an interview. Questions: 562-231-1200.
notes: It can take up to two months to start after you apply, so plan ahead if you need hours by a certain date. This is a general volunteer program, not a teen program.
